Enclosing interface:

Represents a builder used to create new ToolTypes

    • includeVanillaMineables

      CustomToolType.Builder includeVanillaMineables(boolean includeVanillaMineables)
      Sets if the vanilla "mineable/" tags are considered correct by this ToolType. See CustomToolType.includeVanillaMineables()
      Defaults to true. Currently only affects pickaxes. Vanilla functionality of other tools is not guaranteed.
      Parameters:
      includeVanillaMineables - if the "mineable/" tags should be considered correct
      Returns:
      the builder

    • overwriteVanillaMineables

      CustomToolType.Builder overwriteVanillaMineables(boolean overwriteVanillaMineables)
      Sets if the tags potentially set by CustomToolType.includeVanillaMineables() should be overwritten by the default speed set for this ToolType. See CustomToolType.overwriteVanillaMineables().
      Defaults to true. Currently only affects pickaxes. Vanilla functionality of other tools is not guaranteed.
      Parameters:
      overwriteVanillaMineables - if the tags should be overwritten
      Returns:
      the builder
